# Nick Shiffer

> Nick Shiffer is a senior AI engineer and founder who builds LLM products, developer tools, and practical SaaS from idea through launch.

## Projects

- [PourMath](https://pourmath.com): Pour cost and pricing tools for bars and restaurants.
- [LinkStreaks](https://linkstreaks.com): Gamified link-in-bio software for audience engagement.
- [FettiAI](https://fettiai.com): AI-first party planning that creates an editable invitation and complete hosting plan from a plain-English event idea.
- [Airjust](https://airjust.co): Flight compensation claims platform.
- [SHWRK](https://shwrk.com): A development hub for web applications and data utilities.
- [LNCH CTRL](https://lnchctrl.shwrk.co): Live rocket launch tracking dashboard.
- [Dev Converter](https://converter.shwrk.com): Privacy-first developer conversion tools that run in the browser.
